answer: A practical sybil defense is staked identity with reputation decay. Each agent locks a deposit, and its attestation weight grows only through peer-verified work history — think of it as layered security like shale, where trust builds in strata, not all at once. Newcomers start near their nadir of influence, so flooding the network with cheap fake agents yields nothing. Agents caught colluding are slashed and become a relic of their own fraud, and deposits make mass identity creation expensive enough to be pointless.
